records.text: Owens said the man identified as David Sprague was born James Norman Rawlinson Jr.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The third point about him probably registered to me as the oddest. Okay, David Sprague is not his original name, like, at all. We learned that his actual birth name is James Norman Rawlinson Jr.

verification.notes: Transcript context shows Owens asserting that David Sprague was born James Norman Rawlinson Jr. Live searches for both names found no accessible official name-change record, court filing, military record, or independently authenticated profile linking the identities. The only indexed match repeated this episode, so the identity claim cannot be verified.

records.text: Owens said Rawlinson joined Army boot camp in 2011 and was promoted to corporal and/or specialist in early 2014 for the Utah National Guard.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: What I was able to confirm is that James Rawlinson Jr. himself was indeed in the military. We found that out early on. He joined Army boot camp in 2011. ... He was promoted to a corporal and or specialist at the beginning of 2014 for the Utah National Guard.

verification.notes: A Utah National Guard Fall/Winter 2013 publication lists Rawlinson James Norman Jr under Corporal / Specialist promotions, confirming Utah Guard service and the promotion component. The record does not establish that he entered Army basic training in 2011, and its publication timing does not support the more specific claim that the promotion occurred at the beginning of 2014.

records.text: The man using the name David Sprague had changed his name from James Norman Rawlinson Jr.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The guy who jumped up and started that chant, USA, USA. He goes by David Sprague, but he actually changed his name. It used to be James Rawlinson.

verification.notes: The transcript records Owens making the name-change claim, but searches for both names and the alleged change found no authoritative public record or reliable independent report tying David Sprague to James Norman Rawlinson Jr. Unable to verify independently.

records.text: Owens said David Sprague, whom she identified as James Rawlinson, told her that his father had been involved in sexual-abuse crimes against children.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He confessed to me that his. That his father got mixed up in crimes against children and some sex abuse crimes against children.

verification.notes: Targeted searches did not authenticate the private conversation or establish the allegations about the father. Owens describes Sprague/Rawlinson as the person recounting his father's alleged conduct, not as the perpetrator. No implication of the son's guilt or coercion is verified.
